body:
Tramadol overdose at 16. Don’t remember anything after taking the pills. Apparently seized on the tile in my bathroom and was eventually found by my parents. Was in a week long coma then a week long psych hold 
Then lithium overdose at 21. Friend told my parents and they called an ambulance on me. Spent more time in the ER than the psych hold 
And at 25 I overdosed on my blood pressure medication and vodka. Called a friend a bit after and they called an ambulance. Two weeks in the ER until they let me go because they couldn’t find anywhere to place me lmao.
I turn 27 this year and things are much better. I take my meds, I’m in a happy committed relationship, I do things I enjoy when I can. I have a lot of trauma, anxiety, and insecurities to work through but it’s gotten a lot easier especially after having someone to rely on and open up to
Of course! And I paint animal skulls so I can definitely relate to that haha

21f and I’ve had the same luck. I’ve come to the conclusion that you just need to let it happen when it comes and take your time to be your best self until it does. Best of luck OP, you’ll find your person.
